calibration.method: Lowercase ELF hash -> unsigned LEB128 -> observed byte substitution
calibration.seeds: Pantheon Q/W/E resource-cost associations; Zyra R/P distinguished by seven -100 resource transitions; then unique constrained source names
calibration.limitation: Calibration is not an independent test; no generic packet grammar or cooldown decode

role_policy: Source script names distinguish phases; no row is automatically counted as a new cast
